title: Using Legacy games as inspiration
author: Ok-Investment4414
selftext:
megaman , earth bound , metal slug , red alert 2 , banjo kazooie , pokemon ... etc . These ip's pretty much have been abandoned or the ip owners do slop releases .  
  
Wonder if serious non slop builders thought of diving into these pools use it as inspiration to make their own games since a demand is already there .The fan base will support a similar version ... take might number 9 for instance , was a flop but capcom ignore mega man fans which lead to might number 9's massive kickstarter . 

The suggestion is more geared towards the cash grab crowd .

Right now poke2darena and need for speed underground 2 web port are blowing up but are not official games.

comments.author: playtetramental
comments.body:
If you’re thinking it, chances are others have thought it. There are so many recreations of games that Anthropic put in guardrails against copying a game outright. I’d be careful around Nintendo IP, too. That can go poorly. 

A new game inspired by something else can do really well. I believe there are very few truly new thoughts, just different combinations of things that exist. Familiarity is something people generally gravitate toward. Anyone who creates games like these would have to add a new and walk a fine line with the audience, many are critical of games made with AI.
